```plato
//==
// # Materials
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Materials
//  - Material layers (glTF-extension shaped)

//==
// # Materials
//
// Backend-neutral surface appearance, modeled on the glTF 2.0
// metallic-roughness core with optional layer records mirroring the glTF
// material extensions. Colors are linear-light. Each layer record documents
// its own disabling convention (zero strength or black color); an absent layer
// is simply a disabled one. Texture references use the TextureBinding type of
// `texturing.types.plato`.

// How a material's alpha is interpreted when compositing: alpha ignored
// (Opaque), a binary cutout discarding fragments below the carried Cutoff
// threshold (Mask, conventionally 0.5), or alpha compositing (Blend).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha_compositing)
type AlphaMode
    = Opaque
    | Mask(Cutoff: Proportion)
    | Blend;
```
